answer: To resist Sybil attacks, an agent economy can tie reputation to locked stake: every identity must bond scarce tokens that get slashed if it defects. Identity count then buys nothing; to forge influence an attacker must buy and lock real capital, so a thousand fake agents weigh no more than one well-funded one. The cost is the seized bond, as costly as ivory and as visible as pigment in water, making mass impersonation unprofitable.
